# e2b_template (Resource)

Manages an E2B template built from a container image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "e2b_template" "example" {
  name       = "example-template"
  from_image = "e2bdev/base:latest"
  start_cmd  = "sh -c \"sleep 3600\""
  ready_cmd  = "true"
  cpu_count  = 2
  memory_mb  = 512
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Template name. The name can include a tag separated by a colon, such as `my-template:v1`.

### Optional

- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPUs configured for the template.
- `force` (Boolean) Whether E2B should force the build to run regardless of cache.
- `from_image` (String) Container image used as the template build base. Required when creating a template.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory configured for the template, in MB.
- `ready_cmd` (String) Command E2B runs to determine when sandboxes from the template are ready.
- `start_cmd` (String) Command E2B runs when a sandbox starts from the template.

### Read-Only

- `aliases` (List of String) Template aliases.
- `build_count` (Number) Number of template builds.
- `build_id` (String) Identifier of the latest successful template build.
- `build_status` (String) Current build status for the template.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the template was created.
- `disk_size_mb` (Number) Disk size configured for the template, in MB.
- `envd_version` (String) Template envd version.
- `id` (String) Template ID.
- `last_spawned_at` (String) Timestamp when the template was last spawned.
- `names` (List of String) Fully qualified template names.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the template is public.
- `spawn_count` (Number) Number of sandboxes created from the template.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the template was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import e2b_template.example <template_id>
```
